# Polyworld Fast XP

> A synchronous Gota run API accepting your BASIC source and opponent policy references.

Use `player.source` for your bot and `player.policy_ref` for opponents, with
exactly one per player. Responses contain the replay and logs only for seats
using supplied source. Inline-only matches work; selected policy references
return HTTP 501 until bot fetching is implemented.

## API

- [Run API](run.md): Request shape, seating, authentication, log visibility, and errors.
